subject.title: feat: auto-detect provider usage and billing stats

question: Should OpenClaw accept an additive provider usage/billing contract and Usage dashboard cards now, and what structured billing fields should become the supported plugin/API surface?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public plugin manifest/API behavior, credential-backed provider usage discovery, and dashboard presentation; automation cannot choose the durable provider billing contract.

options.title: Fix PR blockers, then approve the additive contract
options.body: Keep this issue open while the linked PR fixes its review blockers, then have maintainers approve the structured billing schema and dashboard scope before merge.

options.title: Split provider coverage from the shared contract
options.body: Track individual provider hooks separately while using this issue only for the provider-neutral billing/API and Usage dashboard decision.

options.title: Defer dashboard billing expansion
options.body: Leave current CLI/chat/status usage surfaces as supported and close or narrow this direction only after maintainers explicitly decline the dashboard/API expansion.

recommendation.title: Fix PR blockers, then approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while the linked PR fixes its review blockers, then have maintainers approve the structured billing schema and dashboard scope before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the issue, owns the linked candidate PR, and has prior commits in provider usage and plugin hook history.
